acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Werebeasts family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Werebeast, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Digitigrade Crosscut Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Full anthropomorphic beast with thick pelt, digitigrade legs, heavy claws, fangs, and only a belt and rag left of human dress.
Signature mechanic: Hock Crosscut: one digitigrade leg plants for a low claw lane, then the opposite hock snaps the full beast through a crossing high lane.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a mobile hunter that crosses two claw lanes from different digitigrade footholds.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 patchy fur and long fingers carry a reflective torn-seam conduit; T2 the emerging muzzle and hybrid shoulders gain cheek-pressure tubes; T3 digitigrade hocks and mature claws gain draining claw guards; T4 the broken chain and iron collar gain linked water valves; T5 the horn-and-antler crown and broken runes gain bounded pressure sockets.

Motion/process branches: T1 a sweep with long fingers fills and drains the torn seam conduit; T2 the hybrid pounce pressurizes one muzzle-side tube; T3 digitigrade crosscuts alternate claw-guard flow; T4 chain rotation pumps the collar valves; T5 each crown rune releases one coherent pressure cycle.
counterplay: Cross behind the first planted hock and sever or stagger the belt pivot before the second claw lane resolves. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 pressure loss opens the patchy fur torn seam conduit at the wrist; T2 the hybrid muzzle tube exposes its valve after the pounce; T3 a digitigrade landing drains the active claw guard; T4 the chain-and-collar valve opens after a full rotation; T5 the crown rune exposes its pressure socket after the commanded release.
forbiddenTreatments: Spray that hides hands, hocks, or collar
identityInvariants: A human frame progressively stretches toward animal proportions while hands, shoulders, legs, muzzle, and tail change at explicit tiers.
Gray, black, russet, or silver fur remains distinct from torn muted human clothing, hide, iron restraints, claw, and fang.
Shredded dress, snapped restraints, ritual scars, and restrained moon motifs record the unfinished transformation without defining an affinity.
Loss of human proportion escalates from patchy changes to an authored sovereign transformation while readable joints remain exposed.
telegraph: The thick pelt parts over one compressed hock while the ragged belt twists opposite the raised claws.
